evaluate_hexagon_packing_program: run the evaluator on a hexagon packing program and return its combined score and eval time
verify_hexagon_construction: verify a hexagon packing construction by checking disjointness and containment of all inner hexagons
check_hexagons_disjoint: check if two hexagons are disjoint given their center, side length, and rotation parameters
check_point_inside_hexagon: check if a given point lies inside a hexagon defined by its center, side length, and angle
generate_hexagon_vertices: generate the six vertex coordinates of a regular hexagon given its center, side length, and rotation
